title: Bound on the depth parameter
statement: For every finite binary string $x$, let $u$ be the output of the specified one-pass transducer on $x$, and set $j=\lfloor\log_4 |u|\rfloor$ (with the natural-number logarithm convention). Then $4^j\le |x|+1$.
